title: Sovereign Gold Bond 2018-19 Series III (issued 13 Nov 2018 at ₹3,183 a gram, ₹3,133 online) is due for final redemption on 13 Nov 2026 at ₹14,024 a unit (RBI press release 2026-2027/1486 of 12 Nov 2026; IBJA 999 average of 10-12 Nov): a price gain of about 341% (348% at the online price) by idly's calculation, plus 2.5% a year interest (about ₹637 a gram); the 13 May 2026 early-exit price was ₹15,102 (RBI 2026-2027/246); since 1 Apr 2026 the maturity capital-gains exemption is limited to individuals who subscribed at issue and held to maturity (Business Today, Outlook Money).
